claims.text: The PMO, in consultation with the Palace Office and the Office of the Lord Chamberlain, states that no vacancy in the Throne would arise on the King's passing because Crown Prince Tupouto'a is the lawful heir; that succession is not dependent on the heir taking the Coronation Oath; and that the powers of office pass to the new King from the time of his appointment, expected immediately upon the passing of the present Monarch, without awaiting the oath.
claims.uncertainty: A prospective statement of the government's legal position, issued before the death; not an event record. The newspaper report it answers is not imported.
